entities.name: Abraham Lincoln
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: 16th President of the United States (1809–1865), who preserved the Union during the American Civil War and abolished slavery with the Emancipation Proclamation and 13th Amendment. Assassinated five days after the war ended.
